# Menu

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A curated list of dishes offered or planned.

## Scope note

Grouping of dishes or recipes, e.g. for an event or a restaurant.

## Broader

- [Meal Plan](../MealPlan/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
